name: pt-larry
goal: photo_tools (image_convert) wave 1: Larry authors luma.rs (S), dodge.rs (S), hatch.rs (S). First Rust campaigns: measure which scope suits each member. S small, M exact/byte-exact, L largest algorithm, C crate-facing with the API card.

tasks.instructions: Widen each byte to u32 BEFORE multiplying. Walk every table row, including the rounding rows (0,0,5) -> 1 and (0,0,4) -> 0. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover each rule and every table row; include a partial trailing triple.

tasks.instructions: Rules 1-3 in order: base 0 first, then blend 255, then the formula in u32 with d / 2 added before dividing. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: One test per rule plus the table; include (0, 255) for the rule order and (1, 253) for the d / 2 rounding.

tasks.instructions: Four layers, strict < comparisons, spacing below 2 counts as 2. Check the 4x3 table row by row. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: Test each layer threshold at its boundary (192/191, 128/127, 64/63, 32/31) and the spacing rule.
